title: Potato Farls
description: Traditional Irish potato farls — starchy mashed potato, plain flour and melted butter, rolled thin and cooked in a dry pan. A childhood staple for breakfast or alongside soup.

ingredients.text: 100g plain flour, plus extra for cooking

steps: Parboil the potatoes for about 20 minutes until soft. Drain, dry in a colander, then mash until smooth. Allow to cool slightly.
Sift the flour into a bowl, add the mashed potatoes and melted butter. Mix into a firm dough.
Roll out on baking paper to a circle about 0.5cm thick. Slice into 8 wedges.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat and sprinkle with a little flour. Cook the farls 2 at a time for 3–4 minutes each side until they puff up. Replace the flour between batches.
Eat immediately or reheat in the pan or toaster.
notes: Makes 8 farls. Store wrapped in foil or covered in fridge for up to 4 days.
